浅钢蓝灰连帽外套（帽兜在头后）
黑色拉链内搭 + 领口少量紫色内衬
right_female: 椭圆深色半镜面太阳镜
浅紫连帽外套 + 白色拉链带 + 驼色图案与 CAMEL 刺绣

must_not_change: 背景结构位置：石墙/栈道/铺装/木棚栏杆/远山轮廓/云
content.distant_people: 保留原有分布、疏密与体量，允许概括为低对比色团，不得清空

light.contact_shadows: 下巴与发下短接触影，方向随主光
light.ambient: 蓝色天光进入暗部，但保留最深稳定暗形

verified_anchors.caveat: hazy sky only; keep the source's saturated blue hue
dark anchor confirmed; knit material not confirmed

color.unmatched_rule: keep the photo's own hue and value relationships; translate drawing language only; do not substitute film blue panels, car paint, interior walls or roof tiles

faces.required: cinematic animation head redesign, identity preserved, both persons different from each other

person_contour.required: visible line-width jumps and local line breaks on each main person at full-image scale; lit edges carried by colour planes; local two-colour misregistration as a separate layer
forbidden: print texture used instead of form

depth.mid: hands, jackets, stone wall, boardwalk keep structure
depth.far: rock walls, forest, hut, visitors merged into low-contrast shapes; window grids and small text may become unreadable

print_layers.halftone_dots: few readable large dots on existing colour planes (jacket light bands, stone wall, paving); never on faces
print_layers.hatching: mid-scale lines following form and shadow direction (jaw/nose side, cloth folds, stone shadow, tree shadow)
print_layers.screen_mesh: wide low-contrast fine mesh on larger secondary surfaces (sky, paving, walls, wood); distinguishable from compression noise at 100%
print_layers.dual_registration: local two-colour misregistration on each person's body/clothing (narrow) plus softer wider lower-contrast misregistration on background structure edges; stable core, aligned features

materials.skin: matte planes, limited soft transitions, selective lines around forehead/brow/nose/mouth; clean highlights
materials.hair: grouped masses first, few directional light strands, no per-strand tracing
materials.coated_nylon: broad soft light bands plus visible seams; no plastic white blotches; folds keep thickness
materials.black_knit: large dark mass with narrow light edge at shoulder and neckline
materials.mirror_lens: reflection / transmission / surface highlight separated; keep the photo's reflection layout; no invented eyes
materials.stone: matte broad planes, joints separated from volume shadows, no mirror reflection
materials.wood: plank joints and grain direction, thickness readable, not flat orange-brown
materials.conifer: trunk and crown masses, few vertical bark lines near, merged low-detail dark masses far
materials.sky_cloud: broad colour fields with halftone transitions, soft cloud edges
materials.snow: soft thick edges on support surface, not white outline, not self-luminous

effects_permissions.new_text: exactly one confirmed inner caption, no other new text

inner_caption.text_verbatim: 风把头发吹乱了，这张我舍不得删。
inner_caption.viewpoint: right-hand woman, first person inner thought
inner_caption.form: single wide yellow rectangular thought box, flat near-black thick border, fine red/dark halftone dots inside the yellow, no speech tail
inner_caption.typography: black handwritten, slightly slanted, thick-thin strokes, single box
inner_caption.placement: upper empty sky area, clear of eyes, faces, sunglasses, lips, hands, hairlines and the CAMEL embroidery
inner_caption.size: box height about 8%-12% of image height, width by sentence length
inner_caption.verification: character-by-character check after generation; any missing, wrong, garbled, squeezed or merged character fails and the no-text version must be delivered instead

effects_permissions.existing_text: keep the CAMEL embroidery position and shape; small text may be summarised as unreadable strokes
